_meta.description: Named travel centers & rest stops along the corridor, used to seed the toilet-o-meter when API keys aren't set. Cleanliness ratings derive from brand via lib/poi/quality.ts.

entries.name: Love's Travel Stop - Limon
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 359; large lot, showers, decent food court.

entries.name: Pilot Travel Center - Goodland
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 17; reliable bathrooms, Subway inside.

entries.name: Love's Travel Stop - Colby
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 53; recently remodeled, Chester's Chicken.

entries.name: Flying J Travel Center - Salina
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 252; Denny's attached, popular with truckers.

entries.name: QuikTrip - Topeka
entries.blurb: Spotless bathrooms; the QT bar inside has surprisingly good coffee.

entries.name: Casey's General Store - KC
entries.blurb: Pizza is the secret weapon; bathrooms typically clean.

entries.name: Pilot Travel Center - Bonner Springs
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 224; busy hub for the KC metro.

entries.name: Love's Travel Stop - Richmond IN
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 156; last big stop before Ohio.

entries.name: Sheetz - Breezewood
entries.blurb: I-70/I-76 turnpike interchange; Sheetz MTO sandwiches.

entries.name: Sheetz - Monroeville
entries.blurb: Pittsburgh exurb; classic PA truck-stop comfort.

entries.name: QuikTrip - Blue Springs
entries.blurb: I-70 exit 20; great QT brewed coffee.
